source_API_recommendation: Use explicit caller output pair reference: constructor fills output before weak-self callbacks, and returns that same caller reference. A returned-value-only transaction hides required published state when later callbacks throw.

Allocator supplies a live exclusive typed block containing native table identity metadata, existing IoReference and an owner projection. Require nonnull-or-throw for0x1c8 and16 requests. Native owner identity is control identity+10; no host vtable cast or original VA call.

Owner should reuse SAME FrameReadOwner weak-self, ReceiveBufferString input, SocketObject plus distinct backing AcceptorState and SAME SessionCipher. Existing WriteFinishOwner maps d0/d8/e0/e8, but proxy_c8 and16-byte proxy backpointer/iterator require explicit additional projection.

Construct actual temporary SocketObject with distinct AcceptorState and invoke B29 move twice. Clear weak pair AFTER first move, before second; do not replace constructor stores with weak-release assignment.
Use actual reset_session_cipher_02bc70 and destroy_024db0; no mock-reset wrapper, independently split cipher or generic replacement socket move.

Use cached published control across old weak-delete and final strong/dispose/weak/delete callbacks. Do not reload from output/control/owner after callbacks; callbacks may change fields or end owner lifetime.

No automatic shared_ptr substitution, native vtable dispatch implementation, extra destructor recovery or final async lifecycle policy is implied. Required IoReference dispose/delete callbacks retain real code/control/object lifetimes.
reference_obligations: Ordinary no-reentry return is allocated strong1/weak2: temporary strong increment isbalanced; installed selfweak adds one to implicit weak1.
Selected dispose must release the owned weak-self before outer implicit-weak release, as026570 does; a counter-only synthetic dispose is not proof of real owner destruction.

Control remains allocated through dispose callback and subsequent weak decrement; slot08 may finallydelete. Do not access owner/control after final release, including postvalidation, automatic local cleanup or return via a freed member.

An old expired weak may be deleted after output publication and after new weak installation. Its callback may mutate output or new control counts; final strong release must still target the cached control and read weak AFTER disposal.
allocation_and_failure_limits: Retained04b0bc retries malloc/new-handler then terminal throws; no valid normal null allocation is supported. Native firstnull branch leads object0x10/control0 and low-memory dereference, not empty success;16-byte allocation is dereferenced without null check.
Before temporary destruction succeeds output remains untouched; earlier source socket movement, registry insertion, input/deque initialization and handler reset are already visible.
After output stores, oldweak-delete or final dispose/delete failures leave publication and prior field/refcount effects visible. Do not roll back output or blindly retry.

Normal ASM is not complete native EH/funclet cleanup proof. Implicit RAII counter release on a synthetic callback throw must not be presented as observed native unwind. Provider allocation and partial construction cleanup remain explicit obligations.
native_lifetime_limit: 023000 selfweak does not protect detached raw-owner jobs. Existing025480 captures only owner token in closure, and user must keep all owner/context/code alive until async operations and raw jobs are externally drained. Constructor success is not quiescence/unload proof.

root_API_proposal_review.agreement: Proposed SessionControl:IoReference embedding SessionOwner with FrameReadOwner, real SocketObject/state/input/deque/cipher plus persistent single-use Scratch fits the observed normal body. No production code has been audited at this proposal stage.
cautions: Delete copy/move of persistent Scratch, which embeds SocketObject referencing its own AcceptorState. Keep owner/control addresses stable and avoid generated moves that retain links to old backing.
Owner address cast is an opaque identity only. Native-relative owner+10/a8/c8/f0 tokens need explicit typed bindings, not reinterpretation of host field offsets.
Clear only weak_self.object_00/control_08 after first move; preserve host-only input_a8 pointer to the same owner.input. Do not assign an empty entire FrameReadOwner and lose linkage.

Persistent Scratch retains the temporary registered socket across lower/proxy failures; caller and allocator must retain all partial block/scratch/service/code state until separate safe cleanup. This prevents stack dangling but does not prove native EH rollback.

Retained Scratch allocation may point to freed control after final cached strong/dispose/delete. No owner/control postvalidation or implicit cleanup may dereference it after final release. Scratch itself must remain caller-alive through call.
Allocator nullptr->bad_alloc is an out-of-contract diagnostic, not native null behavior; allocate throw may have unknown lower outcome and must be retained by lower if it created state.

Control dispose must destroy/release its owned selfweak and proxy/input/socket resources; deleteSlot08 must not dispose them a second time. Full selected control provider implementation/native deleter recovery remains explicit.
